read_with: Protected Characteristic Proxying and Disparate Impact

ontological.core: The cross-cutting Rights-Floor concept securing accessible conditions for sentient participation in constitutionally relevant domains.
scope_exclusions: ordinary default-affordance deployments that do not produce a participation-capacity gap

evaluative.test_focus: substantive participation effect, not formal-affordance compliance
detection_requirements: detect 'general access' patterns that defer to default affordances without producing participation capacity
detect paper-only accommodations that are operationally unreachable
detect selective Materiality arguments used to scale accommodation below the participation floor
scaling_factors: Dependency on the entity, system, or venue
evaluative.burden: The entity asserting compliance bears the burden of showing substantive-effect satisfaction.

non_compliant_conditions: 'general access' patterns used to defeat substantive-effect participation
accommodations that exist on paper but are operationally unreachable
selective-Materiality arguments used to scale accessibility below the floor in materially implicated contexts
cost arguments that function as disguised exclusion
